prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Need a website
Hello Dear Developers , I need a clone of a website which is https://estudyprofs.com/ , Need to be similar some functionalities could be different but most of it should be same , i will only provide with domain you have to buy everything you need such as api's
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need a similar clone of estudyprofs.com, with most of the same functionality and a setup built around the domain you provide.  

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I can build the site to match the structure and user flow you want, while adapting any features that should differ. I’m also comfortable handling the technical side of integrating the APIs and services needed for the build.  

Could you share which features from estudyprofs.com must be matched exactly, and which ones you want changed?
